Immerse yourself in the brilliance of Ustad Vilayat Khan, one of the greatest maestros of Indian classical music. Fondly known as the Aftaab-E-Sitar (Sun of the Sitar), his artistry redefined the possibilities of the sitar and left an indelible mark on Hindustani classical tradition.
